intent.objective: Operate the domain agent harness for line fault management: bound every agent operating inside it to the tools, credentials, escalation routes and verification obligations declared here.
intent.outcome_condition: Every action executed inside the harness is attributable to an AOP decision rule, carries a scoped credential, and lands in the append-only case record.

in_scope: All agent operations inside the fault-management harness boundary
out_of_scope: Agent operations in other domains' harnesses
Human operator actions outside the harness

intent.intent_hypothesis: The harness boundary claim: no agent inside this harness can exceed the authority any inner AOP grants, whatever the inner AOPs say, because this boundary is the top-level AOP for the domain (SEC-11).

elements.name: harness-configuration
elements.access_rule: read-only to agents; changed only through the governance of aop-governance

elements.name: case-context
elements.source: the inner AOP run's case context
elements.access_rule: scoped per case and authority level (SEC-4)

context.snapshot_semantics: The harness snapshots its own configuration check at each run start.
context.minimisation_rule: The harness passes agents no more context than the inner AOP's Context dimension admits.

risk_axes.assessment: High: the harness is the enforcement point for every run in the domain; a boundary failure widens authority everywhere at once.
A widened boundary is reversible by redeploying the previous harness version; a leaked standing credential is not.
Every run in the domain crosses this boundary.
Any change to the boundary requires programme-owner approval through aop-governance.
Chain-verified case record per run; harness conformance profile before release.

decision_rights_ladder.condition: Routine enforcement actions inside the declared boundary
Any change to the boundary itself

handoffs.payload: tool access, scoped credentials, the approved action
handoffs.acknowledgement: execution recorded in the case record

handoffs.payload: evidence bundle per the inner AOP's escalation routes
handoffs.acknowledgement: ruling recorded in the case record

escalation_routes.evidence_bundle: full trace with harness configuration snapshot

validation_obligations: At each run start, verify the inner AOP reference resolves to one immutable version (NM-STR-11).
At each run end, verify the case record chain extends correctly.
control.intervention: The harness pauses a run whose guardrail raises an enforcement error; pause events are recorded.
control.drift_obligation: A change in escalation rates or fail-closed rates inside the harness beyond the declared band triggers review of this top-level AOP.

metrics.observed_value: not yet baselined; first hundred runs establish it

variants.name: Standard governed run
variants.trigger: a run starts inside the harness boundary

decision_rules.if: the proposed action is within the boundary and the inner AOP authorises it
the boundary itself is to change
decision_rules.then: route to the programme owner through aop-governance
